messages:
alex (eng-infra): seeing an uptick in correctable memory errors on nodes in aps2b-rack7, GPU ECC counters rising quickly. perf degradation starting on some pods
jamie (sre-oncall): how many nodes affected?
alex (eng-infra): 3 nodes so far: node-5273, node-5278, node-5281. error rate jumped ~3x in last 10m. logs: `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` shows lots of `Correctable ECC` increments
alex (eng-infra): paste: 
```
GPU 0: Correctable ECC: 124 -> 136 (since last read)
GPU 1: Correctable ECC: 0 -> 3
GPU 2: Correctable ECC: 89 -> 101
```
riley (hw-ops): looks like a DIMM/GPU card aging issue. we should drain and replace before they flip to uncorrectable
jamie (sre-oncall): agree. impact? any QoS alerts?
alex (eng-infra): p95 latency for text-gen routes on aps2b is +120ms on average for requests hitting those nodes. small but spreading. no errors surfaced to customers yet
sarah (platform): can we redirect new scheduling from aps2b->eu-west/aps1 temporarily? autoscaler has spare in eu-west, but capacity is limited for dedicated pools
mike (capacity): we have ~8% spare in eu-west dedicated, hosted pool has headroom but cross-region egress costs spike. cost ok short-term to avoid failures
jamie (sre-oncall): plan: cordon & drain node-5273 first, verify workload handoff, then proceed with 5278 and 5281 staggered. who will run the drains?
alex (eng-infra): I can kick off drains now. using drain command: `fleetctl drain node-5273 --reason "ECC spike" --grace 300` then `kubectl drain node-5273 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
riley (hw-ops): I'll open an RMA with vendor for node-5273 and node-5281. recommend full GPU FRU swap, probably radiator replacement if thermal coupling causing noise
sarah (platform): add a routing policy so that new sessions avoid aps2b for 15m: `route policy set --region aps2b --weight 0.2` and fallback to eu-west. i'll deploy now
infra-bot: Incident created: <https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-1189|INC-2026-1189> - GPU ECC spike in aps2b-rack7 (priority P2)
jamie (sre-oncall): tagging postmortem template in the incident. please update runbook step `drain-and-evacuate` when you do actions
alex (eng-infra): starting drain node-5273 -> `fleetctl` job queued. running `kubectl evict` - first batch of pods moved off, 3 pods failed to start due to nodeSelector constraints, patching those to allow fallback
jamie (sre-oncall): ephemeral failure expected, thanks for the patch. monitoring for restart storms
mike (capacity): if drains cause scheduling pressure we may need to temporarily increase burst capacity on Dedicated by +2 GPUs for the next 2 hours. approve?
sarah (platform): approve for 2h, set alert to revert automatically
riley (hw-ops): RMA opened: ticket #RMA-8421. ETA for parts 48-72h. I'll slot on-prem tech for swap when arrives
alex (eng-infra): node-5273 drained fully, evicted 42 pods, traffic relocated. running health checks on target nodes
jamie (sre-oncall): health checks green so far. latency trending back to baseline for requests that hit fallback nodes
infra-bot: Autoscaler: added temporary +2 GPU capacity to dedicated-pool-eu-west (id: dp-euw-9)
mike (capacity): noted cost delta estimate ~+$350 for the 2h burst (egress + reserved GPU price). ok to bill to incident spend line
sarah (platform): rolling to 5278 now, will space by 12 minutes to avoid spike stacking
alex (eng-infra): started drain node-5278. saw a kernel OOPS right before drain start, copying kernel log: `GPU0: ECC correctable++ then GPU reset`
riley (hw-ops): OOPS suggests card-level issue, prioritize that node for replacement first once parts arrive. mark it as DO NOT PROVISION until FRU swapped
jamie (sre-oncall): good call. add circuit breaker: if any node goes unresponsive during drain, abort remaining drains and flip region traffic to 0 for aps2b immediately
alex (eng-infra): copied the circuit breaker into incident runbook and triggered a test failover - works as expected
infra-bot: Alert: 3 incidents correlated: INC-2026-1189, HW-APSE-742. Correlation note attached
mike (capacity): post-evac plan: we should run a quick capacity audit for aps2b and consider a proactive refresh of 10% of GPUs this quarter. costs vs risk tradeoff?
riley (hw-ops): i'll prepare a hardware health report and recommended refresh list. early signs point to a manufacturing batch with higher correctable ECC counts
jamie (sre-oncall): keep me posted. once all three nodes replaced we can close INC-2026-1189. document timelines in incident ticket
alex (eng-infra): all three nodes drained. traffic normalized, p95 within baseline. leaving nodes cordoned until RMA swap. will add remediation notes to incident
sarah (platform): thanks everyone. i'll schedule follow-up review and add postmortem owners
riley (hw-ops): RMA updated with priority shipment. will update ETA on the incident when carrier confirms
jamie (sre-oncall): closing on Slack channel for now. tag me in incident when replacement done. :thumbsup:
